notes.title: Future of Battle Tea Development and a possible ETA
notes.notes:
It's been a while since I last updated this game, however, I have a very good reason for it...
I'm on the last year of a vocational training course related to software development, involving both work and studying. I have little to no time to work on almost anything else besides school.

As such, I'll have to look towards 2024 for the ETA of this game, I'll be able to come back into development around the second quarter of 2024, and I'll finish completely my studies (hopefully) around the third quarter, so I'll return full-time to finish this game.

So my plan is that Battle Tea is being released before the end of the next year.

In the meantime, I hope you enjoy the game as it is right now. I have a lot of stuff planned for the future of this game.

Cheers, AntikoreDev

notes.title: Coming Soon! Battle Tea b1.4 - The Party Update
notes.notes:
We've recently updated our game to the version b1.3, fixing a lot of problems from previous versions, adding some new content, and redoing some parts of the code.

However, the next update will be a big step in the good direction.

[h1]Battle Tea b1.4 - The Party Update[/h1]
This new update will bring up a lot of new content and possibilities, these include but are not limited to:
[list]
[*] Support for 8 simultaneous players!
[*] Support for playing on teams instead of FFA.
[*] QOL improvements, specially on lobby searching.
[/list]

This was done while testing 8-player functionality:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44064528/33c54ed0f147fc94e0ffe0eb09f2180c759ad893.jpg[/img]

Hopefully this new features will bring an even more complete product for release.
Cheers, AntikoreDev.
